versos.grego: Καὶ ἀναστὰν ἅπαν τὸ πλῆθος αὐτῶν ἤγαγον αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τὸν Πειλᾶτον.

controles.web: The whole company of them rose up and brought him before Pilate.
controles.kjv: And the whole multitude of them arose, and led him unto Pilate.
controles.livre: E levantando-se toda a multidão deles, o levaram a Pilatos.

versos.grego: ἤρξαντο δὲ κατηγορεῖν αὐτοῦ λέγοντες Τοῦτον εὕραμεν διαστρέφοντα τὸ ἔθνος ἡμῶν καὶ κωλύοντα φόρους Καίσαρι διδόναι, καὶ λέγοντα ἑαυτὸν Χριστὸν βασιλέα εἶναι.

controles.web: They began to accuse him, saying, “We found this man perverting the nation, forbidding paying taxes to Caesar, and saying that he himself is Christ, a king.”
controles.kjv: And they began to accuse him, saying, We found this fellow perverting the nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Cesar, saying that he himself is Christ a King.
controles.livre: E começaram a acusá-lo, dizendo: Encontramos este homem ,que perverte a nação, e proíbe dar tributo a César, dizendo que ele mesmo é Cristo, o Rei.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ Πειλᾶτος ἠρώτησεν αὐτὸν λέγων Σὺ εἶ ὁ Βασιλεὺς τῶν Ἰουδαίων; ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς αὐτῷ ἔφη Σὺ λέγεις.

controles.web: Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?”   He answered him, “So you say.”
controles.kjv: And Pilate asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answered him and said, Thou sayest it.
controles.livre: E Pilatos lhe perguntou, dizendo: Tu és o Rei dos judeus?E respondendo, ele lhe disse: Tu o dizes.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ Πειλᾶτος εἶπεν πρὸς τοὺς ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ τοὺς ὄχλους Οὐδὲν εὑρίσκω αἴτιον ἐν τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ τούτῳ.

controles.web: Pilate said to the chief priests and the multitudes, “I find no basis for a charge against this man.”
controles.kjv: Then said Pilate to the chief priests and to the people, I find no fault in this man.
controles.livre: E Pilatos disse aos chefes dos sacerdotes, e às multidões: Não acho culpa nenhuma neste homem.

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ ἐπίσχυον λέγοντες ὅτι Ἀνασείει τὸν λαὸν, διδάσκων καθ’ ὅλης τῆς Ἰουδαίας, καὶ ἀρξάμενος ἀπὸ τῆς Γαλιλαίας ἕως ὧδε.

controles.web: But they insisted, saying, “He stirs up the people, teaching throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee even to this place.”
controles.kjv: And they were the more fierce, saying, He stirreth up the people, teaching throughout all Jewry, beginning from Galilee to this place.
controles.livre: Mas eles insistiam, dizendo: Ele incita ao povo, ensinando por toda a Judeia, começando desde a Galileia até aqui.

versos.grego: Πειλᾶτος δὲ ἀκούσας ἐπηρώτησεν εἰ ὁ ἄνθρωπος Γαλιλαῖός ἐστιν,

controles.web: But when Pilate heard Galilee mentioned, he asked if the man was a Galilean.
controles.kjv: When Pilate heard of Galilee, he asked whether the man were a Galilean.
controles.livre: Então Pilatos, ouvindo falar da Galileia, perguntou se aquele homem era galileu.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐπιγνοὺς ὅτι ἐκ τῆς ἐξουσίας Ἡρῴδου ἐστὶν, ἀνέπεμψεν αὐτὸν πρὸς Ἡρῴδην, ὄντα καὶ αὐτὸν ἐν Ἱεροσολύμοις ἐν ταύταις ταῖς ἡμέραις.

controles.web: When he found out that he was in Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem during those days.
controles.kjv: And as soon as he knew that he belonged unto Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who himself also was at Jerusalem at that time.
controles.livre: E quando soube que era da jurisdição de Herodes, ele o entregou a Herodes, que naqueles dias também estava em Jerusalém.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ Ἡρῴδης ἰδὼν τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἐχάρη λίαν· ἦν γὰρ ἐξ ἱκανῶν χρόνων θέλων ἰδεῖν αὐτὸν διὰ τὸ ἀκούειν περὶ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἤλπιζέν τι σημεῖον ἰδεῖν ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ γινόμενον.

controles.web: Now when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceedingly glad, for he had wanted to see him for a long time, because he had heard many things about him. He hoped to see some miracle done by him.
controles.kjv: And when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceeding glad: for he was desirous to see him of a long season, because he had heard many things of him; and he hoped to have seen some miracle done by him.
controles.livre: E Herodes, ao ver Jesus, alegrou-se muito, porque havia muito tempo que desejava o ver, pois ouvia muitas coisas sobre ele; e esperava ver algum sinal feito por ele.

versos.grego: ἐπηρώτα δὲ αὐτὸν ἐν λόγοις ἱκανοῖς· αὐτὸς δὲ οὐδὲν ἀπεκρίνατο αὐτῷ.

controles.web: He questioned him with many words, but he gave no answers.
controles.kjv: Then he questioned with him in many words; but he answered him nothing.
controles.livre: E perguntava-lhe com muitas palavras, mas ele nada lhe respondia;

versos.grego: εἱστήκεισαν δὲ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς εὐτόνως κατηγοροῦντες αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: The chief priests and the scribes stood, vehemently accusing him.
controles.kjv: And the chief priests and scribes stood and vehemently accused him.
controles.livre: E estavam lá os chefes dos sacerdotes, e os escribas, acusando-o com veemência.

versos.grego: ἐξουθενήσας δὲ αὐτὸν ὁ Ἡρῴδης σὺν τοῖς στρατεύμασιν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐμπαίξας, περιβαλὼν ἐσθῆτα λαμπρὰν ἀνέπεμψεν αὐτὸν τῷ Πειλάτῳ.

controles.web: Herod with his soldiers humiliated him and mocked him. Dressing him in luxurious clothing, they sent him back to Pilate.
controles.kjv: And Herod with his men of war set him at nought, and mocked him, and arrayed him in a gorgeous robe, and sent him again to Pilate.
controles.livre: E Herodes, com seus soldados, desprezando-o, e escarnecendo dele, o vestiu com uma roupa luxuosa, e o enviou de volta a Pilatos.

versos.grego: ἐγένοντο δὲ φίλοι ὅ τε Ἡρῴδης καὶ ὁ Πειλᾶτος ἐν αὐτῇ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ μετ’ ἀλλήλων· προϋπῆρχον γὰρ ἐν ἔχθρᾳ ὄντες πρὸς αὑτούς.

controles.web: Herod and Pilate became friends with each other that very day, for before that they were enemies with each other.
controles.kjv: And the same day Pilate and Herod were made friends together: for before they were at enmity between themselves.
controles.livre: E no mesmo dia Pilatos e Herodes se fizeram amigos; porque antes tinham inimizade um contra o outro.

versos.grego: Πειλᾶτος δὲ συνκαλεσάμενος τοὺς ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ τοὺς ἄρχοντας καὶ τὸν λαὸν

controles.web: Pilate called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people,
controles.kjv: And Pilate, when he had called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people,
controles.livre: E Pilatos, convocando aos chefes dos sacerdotes, aos líderes, e ao povo, disse-lhes:

versos.grego: εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς Προσηνέγκατέ μοι τὸν ἄνθρωπον τοῦτον ὡς ἀποστρέφοντα τὸν λαόν, καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐνώπιον ὑμῶν ἀνακρίνας οὐθὲν εὗρον ἐν τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ τούτῳ αἴτιον ὧν κατηγορεῖτε κατ’ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: and said to them, “You brought this man to me as one that perverts the people, and see, I have examined him before you, and found no basis for a charge against this man concerning those things of which you accuse him.
controles.kjv: Said unto them, Ye have brought this man unto me, as one that perverteth the people: and, behold, I, having examined him before you, have found no fault in this man touching those things whereof ye accuse him:
controles.livre: Vós me trouxestes a este homem, como que perverte o povo; e eis que eu, examinando-o em vossa presença, nenhuma culpa eu acho neste homem, das de que o acusais.

versos.grego: ἀλλ’ οὐδὲ Ἡρῴδης· ἀνέπεμψεν γὰρ αὐτὸν πρὸς ἡμᾶς· καὶ ἰδοὺ οὐδὲν ἄξιον θανάτου ἐστὶν πεπραγμένον αὐτῷ·

controles.web: Neither has Herod, for I sent you to him, and see, nothing worthy of death has been done by him.
controles.kjv: No, nor yet Herod: for I sent you to him; and, lo, nothing worthy of death is done unto him.
controles.livre: E nem também Herodes; porque a ele eu vos remeti; e eis que ele nada fez para que seja digno de morte.

versos.grego: παιδεύσας οὖν αὐτὸν ἀπολύσω.

controles.web: I will therefore chastise him and release him.”
controles.kjv: I will therefore chastise him, and release him.
controles.livre: Então eu o castigarei, e depois o soltarei.

versos.grego: ἀνέκραγον δὲ πανπληθεὶ λέγοντες Αἶρε τοῦτον, ἀπόλυσον δὲ ἡμῖν τὸν Βαραββᾶν·

controles.web: But they all cried out together, saying, “Away with this man! Release to us Barabbas!”—
controles.kjv: And they cried out all at once, saying, Away with this man, and release unto us Barabbas:
controles.livre: Porém todos clamavam juntos, dizendo: Tirai-o daqui! E soltai Barrabás para nós!

versos.grego: ὅστις ἦν διὰ στάσιν τινὰ γενομένην ἐν τῇ πόλει καὶ φόνον βληθεὶς ἐν τῇ φυλακῇ.

controles.web: one who was thrown into prison for a certain revolt in the city, and for murder.
controles.kjv: (Who for a certain sedition made in the city, and for murder, was cast into prison.)
controles.livre: (O qual por uma rebelião feita na cidade, e por uma morte, tinha sido lançado na prisão).

versos.grego: πάλιν δὲ ὁ Πειλᾶτος προσεφώνησεν αὐτοῖς, θέλων ἀπολῦσαι τὸν Ἰησοῦν.

controles.web: Then Pilate spoke to them again, wanting to release Jesus,
controles.kjv: Pilate therefore, willing to release Jesus, spake again to them.
controles.livre: Pilatos falou-lhes então outra vez, querendo soltar Jesus.

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ ἐπεφώνουν λέγοντες Σταύρου σταύρου αὐτόν.

controles.web: but they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify him!”
controles.kjv: But they cried, saying, Crucify him, crucify him.
controles.livre: Mas eles clamavam, dizendo: Crucifica -o ! crucifica-o!

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ τρίτον εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς Τί γὰρ κακὸν ἐποίησεν οὗτος; οὐδὲν αἴτιον θανάτου εὗρον ἐν αὐτῷ· παιδεύσας οὖν αὐτὸν ἀπολύσω.

controles.web: He said to them the third time, “Why? What evil has this man done? I have found no capital crime in him. I will therefore chastise him and release him.”
controles.kjv: And he said unto them the third time, Why, what evil hath he done? I have found no cause of death in him: I will therefore chastise him, and let him go.
controles.livre: E ele lhes disse a terceira vez: Pois que mal este fez? Nenhuma culpa de morte nele eu achei. Então eu o castigarei, e depois o soltarei.

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ ἐπέκειντο φωναῖς μεγάλαις αἰτούμενοι αὐτὸν σταυρωθῆναι, καὶ κατίσχυον αἱ φωναὶ αὐτῶν.

controles.web: But they were urgent with loud voices, asking that he might be crucified. Their voices and the voices of the chief priests prevailed.
controles.kjv: And they were instant with loud voices, requiring that he might be crucified. And the voices of them and of the chief priests prevailed.
controles.livre: Mas eles continuavam, com grandes gritos, pedindo que fosse crucificado. E seus gritos, e os dos chefes dos sacerdotes, prevaleceram.

versos.grego: καὶ Πειλᾶτος ἐπέκρινεν γενέσθαι τὸ αἴτημα αὐτῶν·

controles.web: Pilate decreed that what they asked for should be done.
controles.kjv: And Pilate gave sentence that it should be as they required.
controles.livre: Então Pilatos julgou que se fizesse o que pediam.

versos.grego: ἀπέλυσεν δὲ τὸν διὰ στάσιν καὶ φόνον βεβλημένον εἰς φυλακὴν, ὃν ᾐτοῦντο, τὸν δὲ Ἰησοῦν παρέδωκεν τῷ θελήματι αὐτῶν.

controles.web: He released him who had been thrown into prison for insurrection and murder, for whom they asked, but he delivered Jesus up to their will.
controles.kjv: And he released unto them him that for sedition and murder was cast into prison, whom they had desired; but he delivered Jesus to their will.
controles.livre: E soltou-lhes ao que fora lançado na prisão por uma rebelião e uma morte, que era o que pediam; porém a Jesus lhes entregou à sua vontade.

versos.grego: Καὶ ὡς ἀπήγαγον αὐτόν, ἐπιλαβόμενοι Σίμωνά τινα Κυρηναῖον ἐρχόμενον ἀπ’ ἀγροῦ ἐπέθηκαν αὐτῷ τὸν σταυρὸν φέρειν ὄπισθεν τοῦ Ἰησοῦ.

controles.web: When they led him away, they grabbed one Simon of Cyrene, coming from the country, and laid on him the cross, to carry it after Jesus.
controles.kjv: And as they led him away, they laid hold upon one Simon, a Cyrenian, coming out of the country, and on him they laid the cross, that he might bear it after Jesus.
controles.livre: E enquanto o levavam, tomaram a um Simão Cireneu, que vinha do campo, e puseram-lhe a cruz às costas, para que a levasse atrás de Jesus.

versos.grego: Ἠκολούθει δὲ αὐτῷ πολὺ πλῆθος τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ γυναικῶν αἳ ἐκόπτοντο καὶ ἐθρήνουν αὐτόν.

controles.web: A great multitude of the people followed him, including women who also mourned and lamented him.
controles.kjv: And there followed him a great company of people, and of women, which also bewailed and lamented him.
controles.livre: E seguia-o uma grande multidão do povo, e de mulheres, as quais também ficavam desconsoladas, e lamentavam por ele.

versos.grego: στραφεὶς δὲ πρὸς αὐτὰς Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν Θυγατέρες Ἱερουσαλήμ, μὴ κλαίετε ἐπ’ ἐμέ· πλὴν ἐφ’ ἑαυτὰς κλαίετε καὶ ἐπὶ τὰ τέκνα ὑμῶν,

controles.web: But Jesus, turning to them, said, “Daughters of Jerusalem, don’t weep for me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.
controles.kjv: But Jesus turning unto them said, Daughters of Jerusalem, weep not for me, but weep for yourselves, and for your children.
controles.livre: E Jesus, virando-se para elas, disse: Filhas de Jerusalém, não choreis por mim, mas chorai por vós mesmas, e por vossos filhos.

versos.grego: ὅτι ἰδοὺ ἔρχονται ἡμέραι ἐν αἷς ἐροῦσιν Μακάριαι αἱ στεῖραι, καὶ αἱ κοιλίαι αἳ οὐκ ἐγέννησαν, καὶ μαστοὶ οἳ οὐκ ἔθρεψαν.

controles.web: For behold, the days are coming in which they will say, ‘Blessed are the barren, the wombs that never bore, and the breasts that never nursed.’
controles.kjv: For, behold, the days are coming, in the which they shall say, Blessed are the barren, and the wombs that never bare, and the paps which never gave suck.
controles.livre: Porque eis que vêm dias em que dirão: Bem-aventuradas as estéreis, e os ventres que não deram a luz, e os peitos que não amamentaram.

versos.grego: τότε ἄρξονται λέγειν τοῖς ὄρεσιν Πέσατε ἐφ’ ἡμᾶς, καὶ τοῖς βουνοῖς Καλύψατε ἡμᾶς·

controles.web: Then they will begin to tell the mountains, ‘Fall on us!’ and tell the hills, ‘Cover us.’
controles.kjv: Then shall they begin to say to the mountains, Fall on us; and to the hills, Cover us.
controles.livre: Então começarão a dizer aos montes: Cai sobre nós; E aos morros: Cobri-nos!

versos.grego: ὅτι εἰ ἐν ὑγρῷ ξύλῳ ταῦτα ποιοῦσιν, ἐν τῷ ξηρῷ τί γένηται;

controles.web: For if they do these things in the green tree, what will be done in the dry?”
controles.kjv: For if they do these things in a green tree, what shall be done in the dry?
controles.livre: Porque, se fazem isto à árvore verde, o que se fará com a árvore seca?

versos.grego: Ἤγοντο δὲ καὶ ἕτεροι κακοῦργοι δύο σὺν αὐτῷ ἀναιρεθῆναι.

controles.web: There were also others, two criminals, led with him to be put to death.
controles.kjv: And there were also two other, malefactors, led with him to be put to death.
controles.livre: E também levaram outros dois, que eram malfeitores, para matar com ele.

versos.grego: Καὶ ὅτε ἦλθον ἐπὶ τὸν τόπον τὸν καλούμενον Κρανίον, ἐκεῖ ἐσταύρωσαν αὐτὸν καὶ τοὺς κακούργους, ὃν μὲν ἐκ δεξιῶν ὃν δὲ ἐξ ἀριστερῶν.

controles.web: When they came to the place that is called The Skull, they crucified him there with the criminals, one on the right and the other on the left.
controles.kjv: And when they were come to the place, which is called Calvary, there they crucified him, and the malefactors, one on the right hand, and the other on the left.
controles.livre: E quando chegaram ao lugar, chamado a Caveira, o crucificaram ali, e aos malfeitores, um à direita, e outro à esquerda.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς ἔλεγεν Πάτερ, ἄφες αὐτοῖς· οὐ γὰρ οἴδασιν τί ποιοῦσιν. διαμεριζόμενοι δὲ τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ ἔβαλον κλήρους.

controles.web: Jesus said, “Father, forgive them, for they don’t know what they are doing.”   Dividing his garments among them, they cast lots.
controles.kjv: Then said Jesus, Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do. And they parted his raiment, and cast lots.
controles.livre: E Jesus dizia: Pai, perdoa-lhes, porque não sabem o que fazem. E, repartindo suas roupas, lançaram sortes.

versos.grego: καὶ εἱστήκει ὁ λαὸς θεωρῶν. ἐξεμυκτήριζον δὲ καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες λέγοντες Ἄλλους ἔσωσεν, σωσάτω ἑαυτόν, εἰ οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ Χριστὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ ὁ ἐκλεκτός.

controles.web: The people stood watching. The rulers with them also scoffed at him, saying, “He saved others. Let him save himself, if this is the Christ of God, his chosen one!”
controles.kjv: And the people stood beholding. And the rulers also with them derided him, saying, He saved others; let him save himself, if he be Christ, the chosen of God.
controles.livre: E o povo estava olhando; e os líderes também zombavam com eles, dizendo: Salvou a outros, salve agora a si mesmo, se é o Cristo, o escolhido de Deus.

versos.grego: ἐνέπαιξαν δὲ αὐτῷ καὶ οἱ στρατιῶται προσερχόμενοι, ὄξος προσφέροντες αὐτῷ

controles.web: The soldiers also mocked him, coming to him and offering him vinegar,
controles.kjv: And the soldiers also mocked him, coming to him, and offering him vinegar,
controles.livre: E os soldados também escarneciam dele, aproximando-se dele, e mostrando-lhe vinagre;

versos.grego: καὶ λέγοντες Εἰ σὺ εἶ ὁ Βασιλεὺς τῶν Ἰουδαίων, σῶσον σεαυτόν.

controles.web: and saying, “If you are the King of the Jews, save yourself!”
controles.kjv: And saying, If thou be the king of the Jews, save thyself.
controles.livre: E dizendo: Se tu és o Rei dos judeus, salva a ti mesmo.

versos.grego: ἦν δὲ καὶ ἐπιγραφὴ ἐπ’ αὐτῷ Ο ΒΑΣΙΛΕΥΣ ΤΩΝ ΙΟΥΔΑΙΩΝ ΟΥΤΟΣ.

controles.web: An inscription was also written over him in letters of Greek, Latin, and Hebrew: “THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.”
controles.kjv: And a superscription also was written over him in letters of Greek, and Latin, and Hebrew, THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
controles.livre: E também estava acima dele um título escrito com letras gregas, romanas e hebraicas: ESTE É O REI DOS JUDEUS.

versos.grego: Εἷς δὲ τῶν κρεμασθέντων κακούργων ἐβλασφήμει αὐτόν Οὐχὶ σὺ εἶ ὁ Χριστός; σῶσον σεαυτὸν καὶ ἡμᾶς.

controles.web: One of the criminals who was hanged insulted him, saying, “If you are the Christ, save yourself and us!”
controles.kjv: And one of the malefactors which were hanged railed on him, saying, If thou be Christ, save thyself and us.
controles.livre: E um dos malfeitores que estavam pendurados o insultava, dizendo: Se tu és o Cristo, salva a ti mesmo, e a nós.

versos.grego: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ ἕτερος ἐπιτιμῶν αὐτῷ ἔφη Οὐδὲ φοβῇ σὺ τὸν Θεόν, ὅτι ἐν τῷ αὐτῷ κρίματι εἶ;

controles.web: But the other answered, and rebuking him said, “Don’t you even fear God, seeing you are under the same condemnation?
controles.kjv: But the other answering rebuked him, saying, Dost not thou fear God, seeing thou art in the same condemnation?
controles.livre: Porém o outro, respondendo, repreendia-o, dizendo: Tu ainda não temes a Deus, mesmo estando na mesma condenação?

versos.grego: καὶ ἡμεῖς μὲν δικαίως, ἄξια γὰρ ὧν ἐπράξαμεν ἀπολαμβάνομεν· οὗτος δὲ οὐδὲν ἄτοπον ἔπραξεν.

controles.web: And we indeed justly, for we receive the due reward for our deeds, but this man has done nothing wrong.”
controles.kjv: And we indeed justly; for we receive the due reward of our deeds: but this man hath done nothing amiss.
controles.livre: E nós realmente estamos sendo punidos justamente, porque estamos recebendo de volta merecidamente por aquilo que praticamos; mas este nada fez de errado.

versos.grego: καὶ ἔλεγεν Ἰησοῦ, μνήσθητί μου ὅταν ἔλθῃς εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν σου.

controles.web: He said to Jesus, “Lord, remember me when you come into your Kingdom.”
controles.kjv: And he said unto Jesus, Lord, remember me when thou comest into thy kingdom.
controles.livre: E disse a Jesus: Senhor, lembra-te de mim, quando chegares em teu Reino.

versos.grego: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ἀμήν σοι λέγω, σήμερον μετ’ ἐμοῦ ἔσῃ ἐν τῷ Παραδείσῳ.

controles.web: Jesus said to him, “Assuredly I tell you, today you will be with me in Paradise.”
controles.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, To day shalt thou be with me in paradise.
controles.livre: E Jesus lhe disse: Em verdade te digo, hoje estarás comigo no paraíso.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἦν ἤδη ὡσεὶ ὥρα ἕκτη καὶ σκότος ἐγένετο ἐφ’ ὅλην τὴν γῆν ἕως ὥρας ἐνάτης

controles.web: It was now about the sixth hour, and darkness came over the whole land until the ninth hour.
controles.kjv: And it was about the sixth hour, and there was a darkness over all the earth until the ninth hour.
controles.livre: E era já quase a hora sexta, e houve trevas em toda a terra, até a hora nona.

versos.grego: τοῦ ἡλίου ἐκλιπόντος, ἐσχίσθη δὲ τὸ καταπέτασμα τοῦ ναοῦ μέσον.

controles.web: The sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was torn in two.
controles.kjv: And the sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was rent in the midst.
controles.livre: E o sol se escureceu, e o véu do templo se rasgou ao meio.

versos.grego: καὶ φωνήσας φωνῇ μεγάλῃ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν Πάτερ, εἰς χεῖράς σου παρατίθεμαι τὸ πνεῦμά μου. τοῦτο δὲ εἰπὼν ἐξέπνευσεν.

controles.web: Jesus, crying with a loud voice, said, “Father, into your hands I commit my spirit!” Having said this, he breathed his last.
controles.kjv: And when Jesus had cried with a loud voice, he said, Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit: and having said thus, he gave up the ghost.
controles.livre: E Jesus, clamando em alta voz, disse: Pai, em tuas mãos eu entrego meu espírito.E tendo dito isto, parou de respirar.

versos.grego: ἰδὼν δὲ ὁ ἑκατοντάρχης τὸ γενόμενον ἐδόξαζεν τὸν Θεὸν λέγων Ὄντως ὁ ἄνθρωπος οὗτος δίκαιος ἦν.

controles.web: When the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, “Certainly this was a righteous man.”
controles.kjv: Now when the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, Certainly this was a righteous man.
controles.livre: E o centurião, vendo o o que tinha acontecido, deu glória a Deus, dizendo: Verdadeiramente este homem era justo.

versos.grego: καὶ πάντες οἱ συνπαραγενόμενοι ὄχλοι ἐπὶ τὴν θεωρίαν ταύτην, θεωρήσαντες τὰ γενόμενα, τύπτοντες τὰ στήθη ὑπέστρεφον.

controles.web: All the multitudes that came together to see this, when they saw the things that were done, returned home beating their breasts.
controles.kjv: And all the people that came together to that sight, beholding the things which were done, smote their breasts, and returned.
controles.livre: E todas as multidões que se juntavam para observar, vendo o que tinha acontecido, voltaram, batendo nos peitos.

versos.grego: εἱστήκεισαν δὲ πάντες οἱ γνωστοὶ αὐτῷ ἀπὸ μακρόθεν, καὶ γυναῖκες αἱ συνακολουθοῦσαι αὐτῷ ἀπὸ τῆς Γαλιλαίας, ὁρῶσαι ταῦτα.

controles.web: All his acquaintances, and the women who followed with him from Galilee, stood at a distance, watching these things.
controles.kjv: And all his acquaintance, and the women that followed him from Galilee, stood afar off, beholding these things.
controles.livre: E todos os seus conhecidos, e as mulheres que acompanhando -o desde a Galileia, tinham o seguido, estavam longe, vendo estas coisas.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἰδοὺ ἀνὴρ ὀνόματι Ἰωσὴφ βουλευτὴς ὑπάρχων, ἀνὴρ ἀγαθὸς καὶ δίκαιος,

controles.web: Behold, a man named Joseph, who was a member of the council, a good and righteous man
controles.kjv: And, behold, there was a man named Joseph, a counsellor; and he was a good man, and a just:
controles.livre: E eis que um homem, de nome José, membro do conselho de justiça ,sendo homem bom e justo.

versos.grego: —οὗτος οὐκ ἦν συνκατατεθειμένος τῇ βουλῇ καὶ τῇ πράξει αὐτῶν,— ἀπὸ Ἀριμαθαίας πόλεως τῶν Ἰουδαίων, ὃς προσεδέχετο τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ,

controles.web: (he had not consented to their counsel and deed), from Arimathaea, a city of the Jews, who was also waiting for the Kingdom of God:
controles.kjv: (The same had not consented to the counsel and deed of them;) he was of Arimathea, a city of the Jews: who also himself waited for the kingdom of God.
controles.livre: (Que não tinha concordado, nem com o conselho, nem em atos que fizeram), da cidade de Arimateia, da terra dos judeus, e que também esperava pelo Reino de Deus.

versos.grego: οὗτος προσελθὼν τῷ Πειλάτῳ ᾐτήσατο τὸ σῶμα τοῦ Ἰησοῦ,

controles.web: this man went to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body.
controles.kjv: This man went unto Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus.
controles.livre: Este, chegando a Pilatos, pediu o corpo de Jesus.

versos.grego: καὶ καθελὼν ἐνετύλιξεν αὐτὸ σινδόνι, καὶ ἔθηκεν αὐτὸν ἐν μνήματι λαξευτῷ, οὗ οὐκ ἦν οὐδεὶς οὔπω κείμενος.

controles.web: He took it down, and wrapped it in a linen cloth, and laid him in a tomb that was cut in stone, where no one had ever been laid.
controles.kjv: And he took it down, and wrapped it in linen, and laid it in a sepulchre that was hewn in stone, wherein never man before was laid.
controles.livre: E tendo o tirado, o envolveu em um tecido de linho, e o pôs em um sepulcro, escavado em uma rocha, onde nunca ainda tinha sido posto.

versos.grego: καὶ ἡμέρα ἦν Παρασκευῆς, καὶ σάββατον ἐπέφωσκεν.

controles.web: It was the day of the Preparation, and the Sabbath was drawing near.
controles.kjv: And that day was the preparation, and the sabbath drew on.
controles.livre: E era o dia da preparação, e o sábado estava começando.

versos.grego: Κατακολουθήσασαι δὲ αἱ γυναῖκες, αἵτινες ἦσαν συνεληλυθυῖαι ἐκ τῆς Γαλιλαίας αὐτῷ, ἐθεάσαντο τὸ μνημεῖον καὶ ὡς ἐτέθη τὸ σῶμα αὐτοῦ,

controles.web: The women, who had come with him out of Galilee, followed after, and saw the tomb, and how his body was laid.
controles.kjv: And the women also, which came with him from Galilee, followed after, and beheld the sepulchre, and how his body was laid.
controles.livre: E as mulheres que vieram com ele da Galileia também o seguiram, e viram o sepulcro, e como seu corpo foi posto.

versos.grego: ὑποστρέψασαι δὲ ἡτοίμασαν ἀρώματα καὶ μύρα. Καὶ τὸ μὲν σάββατον ἡσύχασαν κατὰ τὴν ἐντολήν,

controles.web: They returned, and prepared spices and ointments. On the Sabbath they rested according to the commandment.
controles.kjv: And they returned, and prepared spices and ointments; and rested the sabbath day according to the commandment.
controles.livre: E elas, ao voltarem, prepararam materiais aromáticos e óleos perfumados. E descansaram o sábado, conforme o mandamento.
